locator: I q.75 a.2 co., Ipsum igitur intellectuale principium, with ad 2
interpretation: If the designated intellectual principle is not a body and its exercise uses no bodily organ, it has an intellectual exercise attributed to itself in which body does not participate. This attribution conditional is an explicit open premise. Read within q.76 a.1: the human being understands through the soul as its form; operation attribution does not identify the soul with the complete human being.
